requiredQueryNote: builder_code is required:true. A read that omits it is rejected with 400 'invalid builder trade params' - no filter defaults to the caller's own builder code.

auth.note: The operation declares no security scheme and the spec sets no root-level security, unlike GET /data/trades which declares the five L2 headers. Recorded as read; builder onboarding may still gate it.

continuation.note: before/after bound the match-time window; next_cursor walks pages inside it. They are independent and can be combined.

timestampUnits.contradiction: One builder trade row mixes both encodings. matchTime is format-free string with pattern-style unix examples; createdAt/updatedAt declare format: date-time. Parse them with different readers.

trade.fieldNaming: camelCase, unlike the snake_case Trade schema on GET /data/trades. err_msg is the one snake_case exception.
trade.amountEncoding: 6-decimal base units as strings (size 100000000, sizeUsdc 50000000, fee 300000, feeUsdc 150000)

builderCodeElsewhere.note: GET /v1/builders/leaderboard and GET /v1/builders/volume on the Data API also carry builderCode on each entry; legacy builders without a registered code return an empty string.
